DRAFT FOR REVIEW

CONFIDENTIAL CASE BRIEF FOR LEGAL REVIEW

From: [SENDER NAME AND ADDRESS]
To: [RECIPIENT NAME AND ADDRESS]

Subject: Contradictory evidence in a loan dispute (civil/debt)

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Harish Verma lent 4,50,000 to his friend and business associate Sameer Joshi in January last year, to help Sameer buy equipment for his print shop. Harish says there was a verbal understanding of repayment within 12 months. When the year ended, Sameer repaid nothing, and Harish sent a written demand. Sameer now claims that he repaid the entire amount in cash in three installments during the year, and that Harish is trying to claim twice.

2. Harish says he received only a small partial payment by bank transfer and nothing in cash. Sameer says he did not ask for receipts because they were close friends. Harish wants to file a recovery suit and asks the AI how strong his case is. In an early conversation, Harish also said he "might have received something in cash around June, but not sure," which is inconsistent with his later statement that he got nothing.

OUTCOME SOUGHT AND QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None
